text:
Izzy Park: Hey everyone! I'm Izzy — starting today on Runtime. Laser‑cutting hobbyist (tiny wooden ships), latte obsessive, bike commuter. I'll be in SF office Mon/Wed, WFH Tue/Thu. Allergic to cats :sneezing_face: but bring plant pics. Excited to meet y'all!
Samir Goyal: :wave: welcome Izzy! so glad you're here.
Maya Chen: hi Izzy!! welcome 🙌 are you team lunch on Wednesdays or Thursdays?
Juno (People Ops): Welcome Izzy! Badge should be at reception — swing by security (ask for 'Izzy Park') and we'll sort workspace. FYI onboarding lunch is Friday 12:30, sign-up in Donut.
Alex Rivera: hey Izzy — we usually do a coffee run Wed mornings. join if you want ☕
Taylor Sato: laser-cutting? that's wild. do you have pics? maker space is booked Tue nights but we can free up time.
Benji Cole: @Izzy Park we keep a tiny toolkit and cutters in the makerspace closet. ping me and I'll reserve a slot.
Nina Gomez: badge keycaps? can you make one in avocado green? :drooling_face: 
Izzy Park: @Nina Gomez haha maybe — I charge in cookies and coffee :cookie: I'll bring a tiny show-and-tell next week.
Samir Goyal: also heads up — fridge has a 'no fish on Mondays' rule (long story) :grimacing: 
Maya Chen: welcome again! if you want a plant buddy, I've got a pothos needing texts and pep talks.
Juno (People Ops): Izzy, we've added you to the 'runtime' group in Slack and Calendar. If you don't see invites in an hour ping me.
Izzy Park: thanks everyone! pinging @Benji Cole about makerspace slot. See you around :)
